Before the stamp comes a fare of £18 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Every relic is counted once. The wharf is on the docket. The karst is checked, not assumed.
